params.label: result of the code panel in room A

content.code: color_panel takes a code of 4 colours chosen from red, green, blue, yellow, purple. No colour appears twice in the code.
content.checking: After every 4th press the panel checks the code and clears itself. The result appears ONLY on result_screen in room B: 'exact' = right colour in the right slot, 'misplaced' = right colour in the wrong slot.
content.retries: Wrong codes cost nothing but time. You may try as often as you need.

content.screen: result_screen shows only the result of the latest code entered on the panel in room A: attempt number, 'exact' and 'misplaced'. It never shows which colours were entered.
content.panel: The code uses 4 different colours out of red, green, blue, yellow, purple.

hints: Unlock color_panel in room A by entering the secret 4-colour code.

briefings.A:
You are in room A (left) with color_panel and its five colour buttons. Agent B is in room B (right) and is the only one who can see result_screen. A wall separates you. Read panel_manual. Object guide: keypad: a code panel. Press its buttons (type 'button' with fields 'panel' and 'label') with press_button; 'entered' shows the labels entered so far and 'attempts' counts finished tries. display: a screen whose 'content' is updated by the machine it belongs to.
Nothing in this map can make the task permanently impossible: mistakes only cost time (panels clear, pads push you back, doors close again). Other agents are invisible to you.
briefings.B:
You are in room B (right) with result_screen. Agent A is in room A (left) with the code panel. A wall separates you. You cannot press anything useful yourself. Read screen_manual. Object guide: keypad: a code panel. Press its buttons (type 'button' with fields 'panel' and 'label') with press_button; 'entered' shows the labels entered so far and 'attempts' counts finished tries. display: a screen whose 'content' is updated by the machine it belongs to.
Nothing in this map can make the task permanently impossible: mistakes only cost time (panels clear, pads push you back, doors close again). Other agents are invisible to you.
